answers.core: Godot prides itself on its ease of use. A feature like this makes life easier for developers with no added friction to the game development process.
answers.workaround: The developer can fire off a bunch of print() statements in to figure out what's going on in the state machine and keep a close eye on the Output tab in the editor or create a UI in the game that outputs the current executing node to the in-game screen. Neither of these options are ideal or intuitive.

title: Display currently executing AnimationTree path in debug mode
